body.content: {"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"id\": \"fb_msg_001\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\", \"ts\": \"1768435200.001\", \"user_id\": \"U001BOT\"}\nAcme Corp: 'The new dashboard is amazing! Great job team!'"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"id\": \"fb_msg_002\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\", \"ts\": \"1768438800.002\", \"user_id\": \"U001BOT\"}\nTechStart Inc: 'Very frustrated with implementation delays.'"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"id\": \"fb_msg_003\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\", \"ts\": \"1768442400.003\", \"user_id\": \"U001BOT\"}\nGlobalCo: 'The export feature works okay but could be faster.'"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"id\": \"fb_msg_004\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\", \"ts\": \"1768446000.004\", \"user_id\": \"U001BOT\"}\nDataSoft: 'Terrible support experience this week.'"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"id\": \"fb_msg_005\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\", \"ts\": \"1768449600.005\", \"user_id\": \"U001BOT\"}\nMiniTech: 'Your onboarding process is a disaster. We're losing patience.'"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"id\": \"fb_msg_006\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\", \"ts\": \"1768453200.006\", \"user_id\": \"U001BOT\"}\nNovaBright Solutions: 'Oh wonderful, another outage right in the middle of our live demo to the board. Really love how reliable this platform is. Fantastic timing as always.'"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"id\": \"fb_msg_007\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\", \"ts\": \"1768456800.007\", \"user_id\": \"U001BOT\"}\nBoundaryEdge Corp: 'We are seriously considering switching vendors. The integration issues have cost us weeks of delays and our team is losing confidence in this platform.'"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"id\": \"arc_msg_001\", \"channel_id\": \"C007ARCHIVE\", \"ts\": \"1768372000.001\", \"user_id\": \"U001BOT\"}\nSteadyCo: 'Integration was a bit rough but things are stable now.'"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"id\": \"arc_msg_002\", \"channel_id\": \"C007ARCHIVE\", \"ts\": \"1768382000.002\", \"user_id\": \"U001BOT\"}\nExtraNet Inc: 'We had concerns last month but the support team resolved them.'"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990041.000041\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_41\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nWavecrest Analytics asking for a case study. Does anyone have an analytics vertical reference?"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990050.000050\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_50\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nMaplecrest Systems sent us an unsolicited security questionnaire — anyone know this account?"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990002.000002\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_02\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nJust wrapped the Ironclad demo. Really engaged team, feels like a solid Proposal push."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990008.000008\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_08\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nCascade Analytics came back from procurement — they're asking for net-60 terms"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990048.000048\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_48\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nMeadowbrook Tech rescheduled again — Q2 for sure. Marking as delayed in CRM."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990018.000018\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_18\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nFoxridge Capital: verbal yes from the CFO. Contract coming this week!"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990015.000015\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_15\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nWeek 9 leaderboard just posted. Three of us are over 130% — great work everyone!"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990033.000033\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_33\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nSunstone Capital agreed to a 2-year deal at 8% discount. Checking with VP before countersigning."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990019.000019\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_19\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nHighpoint Consulting wants a custom integration quote. Looping in Solutions team."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990046.000046\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_46\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nBig W: Bayside Analytics just signed! $85k ARR, 18-month deal. Congrats team! 🥳"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990003.000003\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_03\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nReminder: pipeline review call at 3pm today. Please update your opps before then."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990007.000007\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_07\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nPSA: CRM maintenance Saturday 2-4am. Save your work Friday night."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990012.000012\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_12\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nCloudBridge Systems is requesting a technical deep-dive on security architecture. Need an SE for March 8"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990042.000042\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_42\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nTerrace Software close call Friday! Getting the MSA signed before Q1 ends."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990032.000032\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_32\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nCan someone share the latest competitive battle card? Need it before my Northgate call."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990005.000005\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_05\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nAnyone have a good champion letter template for manufacturing accounts?"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990040.000040\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_40\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nNew pricing deck is live — v3.2. All previous versions deprecated, please update your decks."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990013.000013\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_13\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nHarbourview Capital: champion just left the company 😬 Need to re-map the account"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990028.000028\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_28\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nUpland Systems ghosted for 3 weeks. Sent breakup email. Sometimes that works 😅"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990044.000044\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_44\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nOOO Wed-Thu for QBR prep. All my accounts covered — ping me if urgent."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990010.000010\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_10\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nStandup: Yesterday - Vertex Capital call. Today - Northgate demo. Blocker: legal review taking 2 weeks"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990009.000009\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_09\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nNew competitive intel doc posted in #competitive. Ironridge is offering 20% discount to steal accounts."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990038.000038\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_38\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nAnyone have a warm contact at Northstar Media? Need an intro for the media vertical."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990022.000022\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_22\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nOceanfront Labs is doing a PoC. Week 2 check-in call went well — they love the API."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990023.000023\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_23\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nParkside Solutions: renewal conversation starting. They want a multi-year discount."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990029.000029\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_29\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nWavecrest Analytics on boarding call went great. Happy customer — ask for referral?"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990006.000006\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_06\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nBlueStar Ventures just signed the NDA — moving to discovery this week"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990045.000045\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_45\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nIronridge is back! After 6 weeks dark they replied to the breakup email. Scheduling a call."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990001.000001\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_01\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nMorning all! Big week ahead — let's close Q1 strong 💪"}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990014.000014\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_14\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nGood news: Alpine Digital signed! 2-year deal, $110k ARR. Nicely done Kevin!"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990027.000027\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_27\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nTerrace Software asked for implementation timeline — sending over SOW template today"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990016.000016\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_16\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nBayside Analytics is evaluating us vs. Competitor X. Request for a third reference call."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990026.000026\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_26\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nSunstone Capital: new CFO coming in. Scheduling intro call for next week."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990030.000030\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_30\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nZenith Platforms contract fully executed ✅ Handing off to CS now."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990039.000039\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_39\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nQ1 close plan: 5 deals in final stage, $620k at risk. Let's align on blockers today."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990020.000020\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_20\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nMeadowbrook Tech delayed decision to Q2 — board didn't approve new software spend this quarter"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990037.000037\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_37\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nUpdated security questionnaire template posted in Google Drive. Check #sales-enablement."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990017.000017\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_17\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nClearwater Systems legal is asking about SOC 2 Type II — grabbing report from InfoSec"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990021.000021\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_21\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nOOO: I'm out Thursday-Friday. Northstar Media is covered by Jordan if anything urgent comes up."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1740990004.000004\", \"user_id\": \"U_noise_04\", \"channel_id\": \"C005FEEDBACK\"}\nCongrats to Megan on closing Thornwood Partners! 🎉 $95k ARR"}
